etym.s: [cf. Gk. χυ- in χέω (for χέϝω), χυλός, χυμός; Lat. fūtis, ‘water-pot’.]

spans.s: 2. हु ind. an exclamation in हुं हु, हूं हु &c., Sarasv.
1. हू weak form of √ ह्वे, p. 1308.
2. हू mfn. calling, invoking (see इन्द्र-, देव-, पितृ-हू &c.)
3. हू ind. an exclamation of contempt, grief &c. (हू हू, the yelling of a jackal, VarBṛS.)
